params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50, maximum of 100.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: Token for pagination

params.name: sort
params.description: Method by which to order search results. Valid sorts are barcode, name, modifiedAt, and createdAt. Optionally add :asc or :desc to specify ascending or descending order. Default is modifiedAt.

params.name: schemaId
params.description: ID of a schema. Restricts results to those of the specified schema.

params.name: schemaFields
params.description: Filter based on schema field value (not display value). Restricts results to those with a field whose value matches the filter. For Integer, Float, and Date type fields, supports the >= and <= operators (but not < or >). If any schemaField filters are present, the schemaId param must also be present. Note that all operators must be separated from any values by a single space.

params.name: createdAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those created in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: modifiedAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of a plate. Restricts results to those with the specified name.

params.name: nameIncludes
params.description: Name substring of a plate. Restricts results to those with names that include the provided substring.

params.name: emptyPositions
params.description: Only return plates that have the specified number of empty positions

params.name: emptyPositions.gte
params.description: Only return plates that have greater-than or equal-to the specified number of empty positions.

params.name: emptyPositions.gt
params.description: Only return plates that have greater-than the specified number of empty positions.

params.name: emptyPositions.lte
params.description: Only return plates that have less-than or equal-to the specified number of empty positions.

params.name: emptyPositions.lt
params.description: Only return plates that have less-than the specified number of empty positions.

params.name: emptyContainers
params.description: Only return plates that have the specified number of empty containers (containers without contents).

params.name: emptyContainers.gte
params.description: Only return plates that have greater-than or equal-to the specified number of empty containers (containers without contents).

params.name: emptyContainers.gt
params.description: Only return plates that have greater-than the specified number of empty containers (containers without contents).

params.name: emptyContainers.lte
params.description: Only return plates that have less-than or equal-to the specified number of empty containers (containers without contents).

params.name: emptyContainers.lt
params.description: Only return plates that have less-than the specified number of empty containers (containers without contents).

params.name: ancestorStorageId
params.description: ID of a location. Restricts results to those located in the specified inventory.

params.name: storageContentsId
params.description: ID of a entity, or entity schema. Restricts results to those that hold containers with entities.

params.name: storageContentsIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of IDs of entities. Restricts results to those that hold containers with at least one of the specified entities.

params.name: archiveReason
params.description: Archive reason. Restricts items to those with the specified archive reason. Use "NOT_ARCHIVED" to filter for unarchived plates. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED" to filter for archived plates regardless of reason. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED_OR_NOT_ARCHIVED" to return items for both archived and unarchived.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of ids. Matches all of the provided IDs, or returns a 400 error that includes a list of which IDs are invalid.

params.name: barcodes
params.description: Comma-separated list of barcodes. Matches all of the provided barcodes, or returns a 400 error that includes a list of which barcodes are invalid.

params.name: names.anyOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of names. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified names, case insensitive.  Warning - this filter can be non-performant due to case insensitivity.

params.name: names.anyOf.caseSensitive
params.description: Comma-separated list of names. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified names, case sensitive.

params.name: returning
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Modifies the output shape. To return all keys at a given level, enumerate them or use the wildcard, '*'. For more information, [click here](https://docs.benchling.com/docs/getting-started-1#returning-query-parameter).

params.name: creatorIds
params.description: Comma separated list of users IDs
